packageRules.description: Group all non-major updates into one PR.
Auto-merge dev dependencies on green CI.
Pinned overrides — bump deliberately, not automatically.

pnpm: 10.x bumps keep the pin fresh and are welcome. The major is capped by Vercel, which supports pnpm 6-10 only; pnpm 11 also needs the config migration in KNOWN_ISSUES.md. Re-enable when Vercel lists 11.
